name: Strong Close Into a New Low
note: Shorts the bar that breaks to a new N-bar low and then closes in the top of its own range (IBS above threshold) -- a failed flush whose bounce is already spent by the close. Optional 200-EMA downtrend filter and an optional intraday session window given in UTC minutes-of-day. Covers on the first close beneath the previous bar's low, which is a bar-versus-bar test rather than an indicator.
source: StockSharp/AlgoTrading, strategy API/1501-1600/1598_10_Bar_Low_Pullback -- 'Low breaks the previous LowestPeriod bars lowest low; IBS > IbsThreshold (0.85); optional close below EMA200; exit on close below previous low'
